cands.bio: John Knapp is a Republican member-elect of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 65. He won the May 2026 Republican primary and the November 3, 2026 general election. No further biographical or career details were found.

We found no prior elected office, bills he sponsored, or official actions. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and we found no stated positions from him on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, guns, abortion, schools, policing or campaign money. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him. We found no news coverage or controversies about him.

cands.name: Elaine Beech
cands.bio: Elaine Beech is a business owner who served in the Alabama House of Representatives for District 65 from 2009 to 2018, first as a Democrat. She also served on the Washington County Board of Education. She lost to Brett Easterbrook in 2018 and is running in 2026 as an independent.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Elaine Beech was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We found no stated positions from her 2026 campaign and no completed candidate questionnaire; she did not fill out Ballotpedia's 2026 survey. The Ballotpedia page's list of bills she sponsored was empty, so we could not document specific bills or actions in office. We found nothing showing her stance on data centers or development, and no endorsements for 2026. We could not find the dates of her school board service. We also found no documented controversies or foreign ties.

qual.background: Alabama House member for District 65 from 2009 to 2018, with a 2015 seat on the Ways and Means General Fund committee. She also served on the Washington County Board of Education and owned a small business. She holds a bachelor's degree from Auburn University (1983).
qual.why: About nine years of prior legislative service and local elected office on a school board, plus business ownership, fit the high band for writing law and the state budget. Committee seats were not counted toward the score.
